messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 detected: auth-api 5xx spike across us-west-2; auto-runbook triggered. Start investigating.

sam (oncall): seeing the 5xxs but the Datadog graphs are mostly empty for the last 8m. traces and logs pane shows "ingest delay". can't correlate request spikes.

maria (sre): same. Datadog traces blank, APM shows no new spans. host/infra dashboards not updating. this looks like a telemetry ingestion issue rather than app-level missing data.

datadog-bot: Datadog Status -> https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/abcd1234 (US ingestion backlog) "We are experiencing delays in ingestion and indexing in US regions. Our teams are working on mitigation; updates every 15 minutes."

eli (support): we already have two customers opening tickets about intermittent 500s. Can we tell them status?

nina (prod-eng): app rollout yesterday had a rate-limit change; we started a rollback just now. but without traces and tail logs in DD it's hard to confirm whether rollback reduced error rate.

sam (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) confirm if errors are real by pulling service logs directly from pods and cloud provider (avoid relying on DD). 2) enable CloudWatch metrics & logs tailing for relevant services. 3) create temporary alerts based on CW/Prometheus. 4) escalate to Datadog support with debug bundles.

lucy (observability): I'll spin up a Grafana dashboard from Prometheus (we have exporter metrics still flowing). Also enable local log-forwarder to S3 (so we can grep).

aaron (ops): commands to collect pod logs (helm/kubectl):
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=auth-api -o name | xargs -I{} kubectl logs {} --since=20m > /tmp/auth-api-logs-$(date +%s).log
```
Also grabbing container metrics from CloudWatch:
```
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /ecs/auth-api --start-time $(($(date +%s)-1200*1000)) --end-time $(date +%s) > /tmp/cw-auth-tail.json
```

maria (sre): doing the pod log pull now. sending the file to incident thread and to datadog support if requested.

sam (oncall): handoff: I need to step away for on-call overlap in 10m. @maria can you own connect/mitigation and customer comms for the next 45m? I'll stay reachable. cc @eli for customer updates.

maria (sre): taking it. checklist I'm following: 1) confirm error trend with raw logs; 2) flip alerts to CW/Prometheus to avoid reliance on DD; 3) escalate to Datadog with debug bundle and request an incident bridge link; 4) coordinate rollback verification; 5) prepare status blurb for customers.

eli (support): working on the customer-facing blurb. draft: "We're currently investigating errors affecting API traffic. We're actively investigating and have mitigation in progress. We will update within 30 minutes or when we have more detail." feedback?

nina (prod-eng): that's fine. please add that we are rolling back a recent change and that engineers are verifying. do not promise ETA.

maria (sre): update: raw pod logs show a surge of 429/503s from an internal auth cache; suspect rollout coincident with third-party rate-limit behavior. sending logs to S3 and attaching to DD ticket. can't rely on DD for spans but raw logs confirm errors.

datadog-bot: update from Datadog: "Mitigation in progress; indexing backlog is being processed. Some customers may experience delays in metrics/dashboards for up to 45 minutes."

sam (oncall): incident-bot runbook reminder: if telemetry vendor outage overlaps active P1, we should: a) failover alerting to secondary telemetry b) capture raw evidence (logs + CW) c) avoid noisy reconfig that obscures root cause d) coordinate with CS for transparent communication.

maria (sre): performed rollback verification: error rate on raw logs trending down after rollback. cannot confirm via DD dashboards yet, but cw/prometheus confirms lower 5xx rate. updating incident status to "mitigating".

eli (support): sent customer message to affected accounts with the drafted blurb and added note about ongoing rollback + monitoring. responses: 2 customers acknowledged, asked for postmortem. noted.

sam (oncall): good. a couple of operational notes: 1) open a follow-up ticket to add a secondary metrics path for future vendor outages (Prometheus exporter + S3 log sink) 2) schedule a retro on alerting dependencies 3) keep retention of debug bundles for 7 days for DD support.

lucy (observability): creating temporary Grafana alerts now: threshold on prometheus auth_api_5xx_total > 10/min, forwarding to PagerDuty.

maria (sre): Datadog support responded asking for the debug bundle and exact timeframe. I've submitted the bundle and requested a bridge. waiting on bridge link.

deploy-bot: rollback completed for service auth-api at 2755550120 by nina.

nina (prod-eng): confirmed rollback finished, monitoring. thanks for taking on the handoff @maria.

maria (sre): joining the Datadog bridge when provided. if ingestion lag persists beyond 30m we will continue operations using CW/Grafana and create a post-incident report that separates detection from telemetry availability.

eli (support): closing loop: customers notified, they'll expect a postmortem. adding CS lead to the incident.

sam (oncall): handoff complete. I'll stay on-call page but handing ownership to @maria for active mitigation.

maria (sre): acknowledged. current status: mitigating, telemetry vendor degraded (Datadog ingest lag), rollback correlates with reduced raw 5xx. next updates every 15 minutes or when bridge is up.

incident-bot: paging escalation rule: if service errors > 15m after rollback AND vendor ingestion still degraded, escalate to SRE lead and ENG manager.

(End of thread)
